exposure: Transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: Patients diagnosed with postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) who underwent transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) in tertiary emergency hospitals across Japan.
finding: Even after successful hemostasis through TAE for PPH, a hysterectomy may still become necessary more than one week after the initial procedure.
followup_time: More than 1 week (for hysterectomy after TAE)
